name: Bilgeri Camping
beschreibung: The campsite Bilgeri Camping is located in the municipality of Brand in the Klostertal valley in Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the mountains of the Rätikon and the alpine natural landscape. Numerous hiking trails and mountain bike routes are accessible directly from the site. In winter, the nearby Brandnertal ski area serves as an attraction. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents with modern sanitary facilities. The infrastructure includes a heated alpine pool, a restaurant and a grocery store. The location is considered a quiet starting point for families and nature lovers.
